root.label: Michigan attorney general pay-to-stay collections fiscal year 1993-94

events.label: Michigan attorney general pay-to-stay collections fiscal year 1993-94

slots.name: collections amount
slots.sentence: In fiscal year 1993 to 94, the Michigan attorney general collected only $479,988 against a corrections budget of roughly $659 million.

slots.name: asset recovery share
slots.sentence: During the recession of the early 1980s, as auto plants shuttered and unemployment soared to the highest of any state, Michigan expanded its original law and explicitly targeted pension benefits, annuities, and retirement benefits, codifying that the attorney general could pursue any other source of money and claim up to 90% of the incarcerated person’s assets and estate.

slots.name: amendment date
slots.sentence: A 1996 amendment sought to expand it further to bill incarcerated people for any college courses they took while confined.
